name: Real-time particle isosurface extraction
definition: A technique for fast, high-quality polygonization of isosurfaces over thousands of particles in an unbounded spatial domain using small working memory, generating a triangle mesh for real-time rendering.
summary: Real-time particle isosurface extraction is a technique that polygonizes isosurfaces from discrete particles using block subdivision and a particle cache to avoid dense grids and enable real-time performance.
